_comment: Approved-deployer allow-list for every KriegerDataForge repo with a CD deploy workflow. Maps repo -> environment -> list of GitHub usernames permitted to dispatch that deploy. Enforced by the 'authorize' job in each reusable CD workflow (cd-nextjs-vercel.yml, cd-python-vercel.yml, terraform-run.yml) and in the self-contained cd.yml of arthurs-portfolio and kriegerdataforge-portfolio, which run scripts/check_deployer.py BEFORE the deploy job and BEFORE the GitHub Environment approval gate. Both of the run's users are checked, github.actor (who started the run and chose its inputs, kept on a rerun) and github.triggering_actor (who clicked 'Run workflow' or reran it), and both must be listed; matching is case-insensitive. A repo OR environment not listed here is DENIED (fail closed) — when a new repo is provisioned, add it here before its first deploy. Environment keys must match the value the caller passes to the reusable workflow's 'environment' input: 'dev'/'prod' for the Vercel + Terraform workflows, and 'github-pages' for arthurs-portfolio and kriegerdataforge-portfolio (which deploy to GitHub Pages and have no dev/prod).

automation._comment: Bots the deploy reusables may admit, each named by its numeric user id, the value a run carries as GITHUB_ACTOR_ID, never by a login and never by its App's id. Maps that id -> repo -> environment -> the exact caller workflow path and ref, {"workflow": ".github/workflows/cd.yml", "ref": "refs/heads/main"}. A run a listed bot started is judged by its rule alone and never by the deployers' logins: admitted only where the deploy job's check names the profile 'redeploy', only on a run the bot both started and triggered, a workflow_dispatch on its first attempt, the first attempt standing in for the triggering actor, which a run carries as a login alone, and only from the caller its grant names. The deploy job then holds it to the version and commit the live production target's stamp carries (scripts/deploy_stamp.py). Empty until a bot exists, its entry added by its own pull request.
